newsitem.title: UK: Gas oil markets busy, other products quiet in NWE.
newsitem.headline: Gas oil markets busy, other products quiet in NWE.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Tuesday, traders said, with gas oil cargoes busy.
Naphtha held steady with the short term undertone remaining soft as cheaper alternative feedstocks kept petchem buyers relaxed, although swaps firmed slightly.
Gasoline prices were steady despite some weakness on NYMEX unleaded futures. Eurograde barges traded $1 firmer at $193.50 for balance of April lifting.
Heating oil barge premiums firmed 50 cents, but most attention was fixed on a busy diesel cargo market.
High sulphur barges traded at $82.50 fob. Low sulphur cracked came under more pressure from straight-run, which slipped on a weak cargo deal.
